messages.subject: Cholesky isn't triangular (Eigen precision?)
parts:
Dear All,

Last October, I started a thread here about Metropolis rejection due to find cholesky_decompose() non triangular (link: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/stan-users/triangular$20/stan-users/mwDBnt6lxsk/sK_sPoBdAwAJ).

At time, Bob made some valuable suggestion and with some algebra tricks, was possible to avoid that calculation and run the model. Now I am trying a really simple example that is showing the same issue i.e., the cholesky_decompose() isn't being a lower triangular matrix.

Other thread seems to show a issue close to that (link: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/stan-users/is$20not$20lower$20triangular/stan-users/v0XSxpi0ELY/LNJ5dntfAwAJ). But, reading it, I can't realize how to put the things on the path. I digged more about that, and updated my Boost and Eigen libraries, reinstalled Rcpp, BH as well as rstan, but the issue persists.

Following are the minimal reproducible example:

require(rstan)

model <- '
data {
  int<lower = 1> I;
  int nu;
}
parameters {
  cov_matrix[I] InvSigma;
  vector<lower = .0>[I] alphas;
}
transformed parameters {
  cholesky_factor_cov[I] LInvSigma;
  cov_matrix[I] B;
  vector[I] betas;
  LInvSigma <- cholesky_decompose(InvSigma);
  B <- (2. * nu) * diag_matrix(alphas);
  betas <- nu * diagonal(InvSigma);
}
model {
  InvSigma ~ wishart(I + 1., B);
  alphas ~ inv_gamma((nu + I) / 2., betas);
}
'

fit <- stan(model_code = model,
            data = list(I = 4, nu = 2),
            init = list(list(InvSigma = diag(4))),
            verbose = FALSE,
            refresh = -1,
            chains = 1,
            algorithm = 'NUTS',
            pars = 'InvSigma')

My session info is:

 [5] tools_3.2.3      inline_0.3.14    gtable_0.1.2     gridExtra_2.0.0
 [9] Rcpp_0.12.3      codetools_0.2-14 grid_3.2.3       stats4_3.2.3   
[13] munsell_0.4.2

And the  CXXFLAGS = -g -O2 -fstack-protector-strong -Wformat -Werror=format-security -Wdate-time -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -g $(LTO)

The versions of libraries are Boost (1.58.0.1) and Eigen (3.3).

I am open for any suggestion. I am also open for suggestions on how to avoid to sample from Wishart and then take the L factor!

Many thanks in advance.

FH
